title: Cancer Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Cancer (June 21 – July 22) is the caring water sign ruled by the Moon. Sensitive, loyal and protective, Cancer makes every place feel like home.
personality: Cancer feels everything deeply and remembers it too. Behind a sometimes shy shell is a warm, intuitive person who notices what others need before they say it. Family, close friends and memories matter enormously to them. Their moods can change like the tides, but their loyalty stays constant.
weaknesses: Can hold on to the past
Avoids conflict by hiding in their shell
love: Cancer wants a safe, tender love. They show devotion through cooking, caring and remembering every detail. With a partner who is patient and reassuring, they become incredibly warm and committed.
career: Cancer does well in caregiving, teaching, hospitality, cooking, real estate, counseling and any role where they can protect and support others.
friendship: Cancer friends remember your birthday, check on you when you're down and keep your secrets forever.

faq.q: What is the Cancer personality like?
faq.ans: Cancer is caring, emotional, intuitive and very loyal to family and friends.

faq.q: Who is Cancer most compatible with?
faq.ans: Cancer tends to match best with Scorpio, Pisces and Taurus.
Cancer is ruled by the Moon, which explains its emotional and intuitive nature.
